engagement.note: Illustrative requirement set for a portfolio. Requirement text is summarized; assess against the authoritative regulation and legal counsel before relying on it.

regulations.NYDFS_500: NYDFS 23 NYCRR Part 500 Cybersecurity Regulation (as amended)

requirements.requirement: Board-approved ICT risk management framework with defined risk tolerance
Maintain mapping of ICT assets supporting critical/important functions
Classify ICT-related incidents by severity and impact
Report major ICT incidents to the competent authority within regulatory deadlines
Establish a digital operational resilience testing programme
Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT) at least every 3 years for significant entities
Maintain a register of all ICT third-party service arrangements
Contractual provisions for critical ICT third parties (exit, audit, subcontracting)
Arrangements to share cyber threat intelligence with peers
Maintain a documented cybersecurity program based on risk assessment
Board-approved written cybersecurity policy
Designate a CISO who reports to the board at least annually
Annual penetration testing and bi-annual vulnerability assessments
Limit and periodically review user access privileges (least privilege)
Periodic risk assessment of the information systems
Multi-factor authentication for all remote and privileged access
Cybersecurity awareness training including social engineering
Encrypt nonpublic information in transit and at rest
Written incident response plan, tested periodically
Notify the superintendent of a cybersecurity event within 72 hours
